text:
anna (CS): Quick flag — HavenTech renewal stuck. They require the invoice split across two legal entities (HavenTech US & HavenTech EU). Procurement also wants Net45. Onboarding team says no kickoff until invoices are finalized. Need legal/billing alignment today.

derek (AE): I pushed a 12mo with 5% concession to keep pricing flat. Customer insists on single PO referencing both entities. Vendor codes: HT-US-21, HT-EU-09. I'll get PO scanned.

meera (Legal): We can do an addendum that lists dual invoice entities and payment term Net45, but need explicit billing instructions. Draft clause: 

"Seller will issue two invoices: one to HavenTech US (EIN 11-222333), and one to HavenTech EU (VAT 445566). Payment terms Net45 from invoice date. Customer to attach single PO referencing both invoices"

ops-bot: Note: onboarding hold triggered. Tentative kickoff 2026-06-10 if invoices cleared by 2026-06-03.

anna (CS): Can we accept single DocuSign envelope with PO attached and the addendum signed? That would satisfy procurement.

derek (AE): PO received: PO# HT-2026-333. Uploading to billing.

billing-bot: Invoice IN-2026-9900 (Net30) created for initial pipeline. Flagged for manual update to Net45 and split invoicing upon addendum approval. Tagging finance.

docusign-bot: Envelope env-haven-99 created by anna (CS). Pending: HavenTech Procurement, derek (AE), anna (CS). Link: https://docusign.example/env-haven-99

meera (Legal): Countersigned addendum. Please route signed addendum + PO to billing@ and renewals@.

billing-bot: Invoices updated: IN-2026-9900-US and IN-2026-9900-EU. Terms set to Net45. Accounting note: apply revenue recognition per addendum.

derek (AE): Confirmed signed and PO attached. HavenTech Procurement confirmed they'll process payments separately for each invoice.

anna (CS): Great — onboarding hold cleared. Moving kickoff back to confirmed 2026-06-10. I'll run a quick post-renewal survey at kickoff. Closing thread.
file_note: Dual-entity invoice request, Net30->Net45 ask, addendum, single PO referencing split invoices, DocuSign envelope, onboarding hold and clearance.
